{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
# Look at the unique values to see if any have commas
revenue_unique = sales['revenue'].unique()

# Check if any revenue values contain commas
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)

print(f"Number of revenue values with commas: {has_commas.sum()}")
print(f"Examples of values with commas: {sales.loc[has_commas, 'revenue'].head(5).tolist()}")"}
